Load reconstructed Abubakar (2018) UK PREDICT-TB data

Source: R/datasets.R
load_abubakar_2018.Rd

Loads the digitized individual participant survival data (`IPDdata.txt`) reconstructed from the Kaplan-Meier curve in Abubakar et al. (2018) alongside the aggregate baseline IGRA positivity count (`y = 1444` positive out of `n = 6380` tested).

Usage

load_abubakar_2018()

Value

A list with `progression_data` (tibble with columns `t` and `d`) and `prevalence_data` (tibble with `y = 1444L`, `n = 6380L`, `test_id = 1L`, and empirical logit plug-in estimates `mu_hat` and `sigma_hat`).
